stem:
The masses, $m$ kg, of packets of flour are normally distributed. The mean mass is supposed to be 1.01 kg. A quality control officer measures the masses of a random sample of 100 packets. The results are summarised below.

$$n = 100 \qquad \sum m = 98.2 \qquad \sum m^2 = 104.52$$

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Test at the 5% significance level whether the population mean mass is less than 1.01 kg.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Explain whether it was necessary to use the Central Limit theorem in your answer to part **(i)**.
